sql: select strategy, count(*) entries, sum(case when status in ('settled','closed_sl','closed_tp','closed_timeout') then 1 else 0 end) settled, round(sum(case when status in ('settled','closed_sl','closed_tp','closed_timeout') then pnl else 0 end)::numeric,2) pnl, min(created_at)::text first_at, max(created_at)::text last_at from paper_trades where strategy in ('Pmmsell10','mmsell10') and created_at > now() - interval '7 days' and (strategy = 'Pmmsell10' or split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) in ('KXFEDMENTION','KXINX','KXINXU','KXNASDAQ100U','KXRAIN','KXTRUMPSAY','KXWCMENTION')) group by 1
